title: Auto-Calibration Selection + AutoGluon Ensemble for Brier < 0.22

sota_sources.title: Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting
Stacked ensemble model for NBA game outcome prediction
XGBoost and SHAP for NBA prediction - PMC
Comparative Evaluation of ML Models for NBA

findings.method: Logistic regression with calibration on tabular NBA features
findings.calibration_insight: Auto-select best calibration method (sigmoid/isotonic/none) per model using held-out Brier score
findings.uncertainty_insight: LSTM + Monte Carlo dropout at inference provides calibrated probability estimates
findings.ensemble_insight: Stacked ensembles (Naive Bayes + AdaBoost + MLP + KNN + XGBoost + DT + LR) with meta-learner achieves best accuracy

proposals.name: brier-scored-calibration-selector
proposals.description: After each GA generation, run held-out Brier score to select best calibration (sigmoid/isotonic/none) per model. Currently we use fixed calibration. Auto-selection per model type expected to improve Brier by ~0.002-0.004.
proposals.impl_notes: In features/engine.py: after model.fit(), try CalibratedClassifierCV(cv='prefit') with both methods + uncalibrated, keep lowest val_brier

proposals.name: extra-trees-sweep-political
proposals.description: S17 winning config: extra_trees, 74 features, gen289, achieves ROI=32.19% Sharpe=7.74 Brier=0.22031. Port this exact feature count range (60-90) to political islands P3/P4 which are sleeping and may benefit from diversification.

proposals.name: autogluon-gpu-burst-evaluation
proposals.description: AutoGluon achieves 0.7738 accuracy (vs our 0.7749 SVM-equivalent). Run AutoGluon on GPU burst (Modal A10G / Lightning T4) to auto-search model stack. Use as ensemble member in existing GA.
proposals.expected_gain: Potential Brier < 0.215 if AutoGluon stack beats tabular baseline

proposals.name: shap-feature-importance-pruning
proposals.description: Use SHAP values to identify top-N features rather than random/GA selection. S17 converged to 74 features organically. SHAP-guided init could reach that faster and find better 74-feature subsets.
proposals.expected_gain: Faster convergence, expected 5-10 gen reduction to best Brier

immediate_action: Implement P1 (brier-scored-calibration-selector) in features/engine.py on next engineering cycle. Low risk, high reward.
